case: MySQL/MariaDB TIME(3) exact-half fractional storage mode semantics
contract: Each test inserts 12:34:56.789500 into TIME(3) using both a bound parameter and generated SQL literal.
MySQL stores .790 with TIME_TRUNCATE_FRACTIONAL absent and .789 with it enabled.
MariaDB stores .789 with TIME_ROUND_FRACTIONAL absent and .790 with it enabled.
Both write paths assert the returned native Value::Time, CAST(value AS CHAR), and MICROSECOND(value).

focused.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration time_fractional_half_millisecond_boundary -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

mysql_mariadb_value_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration value_contracts:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other temporal precisions and non-UTC session configurations remain untested.
Other SQL modes, consumer paths, and installed typed edits remain open.
This bounded contract does not close B3 or qualify the 0.2.0 release.
